limitations: Requires finite complete prefix code, strong separation, and exact ratios determined by code lengths.
Does not resolve critical positivity for arbitrary inhomogeneous IFSs.
Historical priority against unindexed papers remains provisional.
scientific_integrity: A proved conditional theorem for complete prefix-code contraction ratios; full generality of inhomogeneous IFSs is not claimed. Self-review is distinct from independent audit.
title: Positive critical periodic content for complete prefix-code contraction systems
